person_note: Multiple sampled passages from the opening, trial, wartime history, and post-trial family material consistently use a nonparticipating narrator who moves among characters and sometimes reports private thoughts. The publisher excerpt independently confirms sustained third-person narration in the opening, while the whole-book study guide explicitly describes the same structure across several focal characters. First-person forms in q02450, q02454, q02456, and q02461 are character speech, and q02462 is an unresolved local clinical voice rather than evidence of an alternate base section. No credible evidence of sustained first- or second-person narration was found; the only material uncertainty is the exact local status of q02462, which does not affect the book-level result.
